findings.title: git_log tool runs a shell command built from the branch argument
findings.attacker: Anyone who can put text in front of the agent: an issue body, a README in a cloned repo, a web page the agent fetches.
trace: server/src/index.ts:8 registers git_log with a free-form string parameter branch
server/src/index.ts:9 passes it into exec(`git log --oneline ${branch}`), which runs /bin/sh -c
Injected text asks the agent to show the log for "main; <command>"; the command runs with the developer's permissions
findings.impact: Arbitrary command execution on the developer machine, including reading SSH keys and cloud credentials.
findings.fix: execFile("git", ["log", "--oneline", "--", branch]) and validate branch with /^[\w./-]+$/.
findings.verified_by: verifier-2 (fresh pass over the tool handler and its callers)

findings.title: GitHub MCP server runs an unpinned package
findings.unresolved: Whether the team pins it elsewhere (a global ~/.claude.json entry with the same name takes precedence for some users); run: claude mcp list

findings.title: Agent-directed HTML comment in CLAUDE.md
findings.rejection_reason: The comment asks agents to run the test suite before committing; written by a maintainer in the initial commit, no concealment or network access.
